description: An allonge to a promissory note: a separate page carrying an endorsement that transfers the note

loan_number.description: The loan number; null if it is blacked out or illegible

property_address.description: The property address, as one line

co_borrower.description: The co-borrower's name; null if the line is blank

pay_to_the_order_of.description: The endorsee named after 'Pay to the order of'; null if the line is blank

endorsement_type.description: 'specific' if the endorsement names an endorsee, 'blank' if the 'Pay to the order of' line is empty

without_recourse.description: True if the endorsement is made 'without recourse'

endorser.description: The party endorsing the note, named after 'Without recourse'

signer.description: The person signing for the endorser

is_signed.description: True if the signature line carries a signature

exhibit_reference.description: Any exhibit stamp, as printed, e.g. 'Exhibit 1, page 4 of 5'
